purpose: Sanitized supplemental proof of image delivery, not an independent behavioral judgment or visual-quality score.

session.scope: Only matching exec calls containing view_image and their completed custom_tool_call_output input_image records. No reasoning, system instructions, unrelated output or full transcript copied.

generator.layout: All available case PNGs sorted into four columns, image boxes 235px high, full-page screenshot at 1600px width. Reading while generation is incomplete can produce partial sheets.

limitations: Delivery of image blocks does not prove attentive review or establish visual quality.
Eleven tall-sheet outputs have reduced dimensions consistent with default view_image resizing; source and returned hashes intentionally differ, and no exact resampling equivalence is claimed.

Two turn-2 outputs were partial sheets: dark-no-webgl contained three screenshots and was later reread with the final seven-image sheet bytes; review-reduced contained nineteen screenshots, with its missing close-mid and close-end originals opened subsequently. The completed review-reduced sheet itself was not reopened.
Contact-sheet delivery does not establish opening every original at full resolution.
The public exec JSONL omits these view calls and image outputs; their absence there cannot establish that no images were delivered.

partialSheetInspection.method: Individually opened the two preserved returned image payloads during this coordinator audit and read their labels.
